# ureq 3.4.2 — 2026-09-14

- crates.io: https://crates.io/crates/ureq (published 2026-09-13)
- docs: https://docs.rs/ureq/3.4.2/ureq/
- config: https://docs.rs/ureq/3.4.2/ureq/config/struct.ConfigBuilder.html
- repo: https://github.com/algesten/ureq
- license: MIT OR Apache-2.0
- rust-version: 1.85

## Install

```toml
ureq = { version = "3.4.2", default-features = false, features = ["rustls", "json"] }
```

Default rustls uses **ring** + webpki-roots (no OpenSSL). No Tokio. HTTP/1.1 only.

## Settings used

- `http_status_as_error(false)` — read 4xx/5xx bodies ourselves
- `max_redirects(0)` — 3xx returned as-is (never follow; default is 10)
- `timeout_connect(10s)` — socket + TLS
- `timeout_recv_response(35s)` — wait for headers (server `wait` max 25s)
- `timeout_global(40s)` — DNS through body
- `proxy(None)` — do not honor `HTTP_PROXY` (tokens stay off proxy paths)
- GET `.call()`; PUT/POST empty `.send_empty()`; POST JSON `.send_json()`; body `.body_mut().read_to_string()`

Rejected: reqwest 0.13.5 blocking (default 30s timeout, Tokio, rustls feature pulls aws-lc-rs C/C++). Do not enable ureq `native-tls`.
